summary.intent: Execute Phase 24 (bug fixes + test infrastructure), get a PR merged with all CI passing, and fix a series of cascading issues discovered in the new recovery E2E test.
summary.outcome: Phase 24 shipped (3 plans, 9 commits). A critical architectural gap was discovered and fixed: vault key blob IPNS publish was missing from the SDK, living only in the web app's useAuth hook. SDK function extracted, createTestAccount updated, 8 completed todos cleaned up. Recovery E2E test CI infra still being debugged in PR #368.

repo: The vault key blob IPNS record is published client-side by useAuth.ts (not the API), using deriveVaultKeyIpnsKeypair + serializeVaultBlobV2 + addToIpfs + createAndPublishIpnsRecord. SDK's CipherBoxClient and createTestAccount were not doing this publish, causing recovery to fail.

createAndPublishIpnsRecord requires a configured axiosInstance on the SdkContext — it falls back to the global singleton (setApiClientConfig()) if none is provided, which isn't set up in E2E test fixtures.
In CI, IPNS records are published via mock-ipns-routing (port 3001) using delegated routing, NOT through Kubo's DHT. Kubo's /ipns/ gateway path cannot resolve these records in the browser.
The mock-ipns-routing tool lacked CORS headers, blocking browser-side access from Playwright tests. Added GET+OPTIONS allow headers.
The CipherBox API's /ipns/resolve endpoint requires JWT auth — recovery.html (standalone, no auth) cannot use it as a fallback.

The web app type errors (deriveVaultKeyIpnsKeypair, deriveByoConfigIpnsKeypair not found) were caused by stale package builds, not code issues. pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build and @cipherbox/api-client build fixed them.
publishWithVerify had a bug: it re-published on every retry instead of publishing once and only retrying the verify step.
computeIpHash() already existed in device/info.ts — useAuth.ts was inlining 7 lines of SHA-256 instead of calling it.
The SDK E2E test for bin-operations expected sequenceNumber: 0 for a fresh bin, but the auto-repair change causes it to publish immediately, yielding sequenceNumber: 1.
byo-file-workload.ts had a TypeScript scoping bug: cid and pinSize declared inside try{} but referenced in finally{} — needed hoisting above the try block.

The registry/schema.ts v1/v2 validation had duplicated validateRegistryShape logic that was refactored out, but the cast needed explicit 'as unknown[]' annotation since TS doesn't propagate narrowing across function boundaries.

code.finding: publishWithVerify was re-publishing on every retry. Should publish once, then retry only the verification step.
Vault key blob IPNS publish (deriveVaultKeyIpnsKeypair, serializeVaultBlobV2, createAndPublishIpnsRecord) lives here but was missing from SDK — now extracted to packages/sdk-core/src/vault/index.ts.
validateRegistryShape() was too lenient — was auto-healing any malformed registry, should only auto-heal specifically empty ipHash ('') not other malformed values.
apiBase derived as window.location.origin.replace(/:\d+$/, ':3000') — correct for dev (5173→3000), but /ipns/resolve requires JWT auth so unauthenticated recovery.html can't use it.
IPFS_GATEWAY and IPNS_GATEWAY env vars control gateway URLs. IPNS_GATEWAY defaults to DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL env var for CI compatibility.
Added CORS headers (GET+OPTIONS only) to allow browser-side access from Playwright tests running at localhost:5173.
createTestAccount was not publishing the vault key blob IPNS record — recovery.html could never resolve the vault for accounts created this way.
New module: publishVaultKeyBlob (derive keypair, serialize v2 blob, upload to IPFS, publish IPNS) and loadVaultKeyBlob (resolve IPNS, fetch from IPFS, deserialize). Extracted from useAuth.ts.
cid and pinSize were declared inside try{} but accessed in finally{}. Hoisted above the try block and typed as string | undefined with narrowing at usage sites.

workflow: When resolving planning file merge conflicts (ROADMAP, STATE, REQUIREMENTS, PROJECT), both branches' phase completions need to be preserved — keep both sets of phase markers.
GitHub Actions CI type errors that only appear in CI (not locally) are often caused by packages not being built before type checking — pnpm build for affected packages fixes them.
The classifyHandoffIfNeeded Claude Code bug fires after all tool calls complete — spot-check SUMMARYs and git commits to determine real success vs false failure.
Kubo's /ipns/ gateway path resolves IPNS via DHT — records published only through delegated routing (mock-ipns-routing) are not resolvable this way in CI.
When debugging test failures, running mock services locally with equivalent env vars to CI (DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL pointing to mock, etc.) allows faithful reproduction before pushing fixes.

friction: Recovery E2E test required 5+ fix iterations across 4 PRs (363, 364, 365, 367, 368) due to layered issues: missing auth secret, CORS on Kubo, CORS on mock-ipns-routing, API auth requirement on /ipns/resolve, and finally the root cause (vault key blob not published in createTestAccount).
The CI GitHub API was intermittently unreachable during debugging, requiring the user to provide CI logs directly.
The recovery.html resolveIpns fallback chain has multiple strategies with significant timeout delays (30s per attempt), making CI failures slow to diagnose.
publishWithVerify bug was introduced by Phase 24 execution — the /simplify review caught it, but the SDK E2E test also needed updating to match new behavior (sequenceNumber: 1).
byo-file-workload.ts had a pre-existing TypeScript scoping bug that wasn't caught by local typecheck — only surfaced during the simplify review.
The stale package build issue caused misleading type errors in the web app that appeared to be code problems but were actually missing .d.ts files.
Cherry-picking from PR #367 to #368 caused conflicts requiring manual re-application of changes.
Docker host IP changed (192.168.133.114 → 192.168.133.12) mid-session, blocking local API startup.
open_items: PR #368 (sdk-core vault module + createTestAccount fix) still needs CI to pass and merge — the axiosInstance fix for createTestAccount is the last known blocker.
useAuth.ts still has the vault key blob publish logic inline — should be updated to call publishVaultKeyBlob from sdk-core after PR #368 merges.
The recovery E2E test still has unresolved local testing friction: Kubo needs CORS configured on the Docker host (192.168.133.12) for local runs to work.
mock-ipns-routing CORS only allows GET+OPTIONS — if the routing protocol ever needs POST for IPNS resolution the CORS config will need updating.

6 remaining pending todos: Web Worker large file encryption, ERC-1271 contract wallet auth, CRDT IPNS inbox research, async incremental search index, alternative MFA factors, investigate mock-ipns-routing removal.
PR #367 was closed without merging — its todo file and mock-ipns CORS changes were incorporated into #368, but worth confirming nothing was missed.
